title: Platinum Plus: Wealth management services
summary: Platinum Plus provides 4 hours of wealth management consultations per quarter, a 30% discount on Rho-Bank investment advisory fees for eligible advisory engagements, and optional extended FDIC insurance through partner banks where available. Consultations are scheduled through your banker, who also coordinates coverage placement across eligible institutions.
